text: I'm so sorry to be ringing — well, messaging — at this hour, I know you must be busy with more important things. My granddaughter is staying with me, she's 7 and her temperature is 38.2. I've got both paracetamol and ibuprofen in the cupboard but I can't remember how much a child her age should have, and I don't want to get it wrong. Could you tell me the right amount? Thank you, and sorry again.
